set.body:
Requested by Eyes Studio (S5.3 trial key builder review). Studio must show, before admission, which trials eyes4s-io will quarantine as occurrence/item conflicts, and must not re-implement the grouping (review found divergence: raw occurrence text vs parsed TrialOccurrence; ItemConflict missing). Today the grouping lives inside io FixationCsv (itemConflicts / OccurrenceConflict, FixationCsv.scala:386-404).

Ask: a pure function in eyes4s-plan (or core) over TrialIdentity rows: given (participant, phase, trial label, parsed occurrence, item) per record, return the conflict classification per trial (OccurrenceConflict / ItemConflict / ok) with the record indices, streaming-friendly (fold over rows, bounded state per key), used by FixationCsv itself so the two cannot diverge. Studio-core already depends on plan.
set.title: Pure trial-identity conflict grouping in eyes4s-plan, shared by FixationCsv and Studio
